title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 6 章‧屍體污染（二）與寂靜之塔
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
cvañtem drâjô zrvânem ainghå
zemô anaidhya ýat ahmi spânasca narasca para-irithiñti,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýâre-drâjô
ashâum zarathushtra ainghå zemô anaidhya ýat
ahmi spânasca narasca para-irithiñti,
segments.en:
How long shall the piece of ground he fallow whereon dogs
or men have died? Ahura Mazda answered: 'A year long shall the
piece of ground he fallow whereon dogs or men have died, O holy
Zarathustra!
segments.zh: 狗或人死去的那塊地應當休閒多久？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「狗或人死去的那塊地應當休閒一年，神聖的查拉圖斯特拉啊！」

segments.orig:
mâca pascaêta mazdayasna tãm zãm
kârayen mâ âpô herezayen ýat ahmi
spânasca narasca para-irithiñti añtarât
naêmât ýâre-drâjô vasô
pascaêta mazdayasna tãm anyãm zãm kârayen
vasô âpô herezayen.
segments.en:
'A year long shall no worshipper of Mazda sow or water that
piece of ground whereon dogs or men have died; he may sow as he
likes the rest of the ground; he may water it as he likes.
segments.zh: 「在狗或人死去的那塊地上，馬茲達信仰者一年之內不應播種或澆灌；在地的其餘部分，他可隨意播種；他可隨意澆灌。」

segments.orig:
ýezi mazdayasna tãm zãm kârayen
ýezi âpô herezayen ýat ahmi spânasca
narasca para-irithiñti añtarât naêmât
ýâre-drâjô nasuspaêm pascaêta
âstryåñte aête ýôi mazdayasna
apasca zemasca urvarayåsca.
segments.en:
'If within the year they shall sow or water the piece of ground
whereon dogs or men have died, they are guilty of the sin of "burying
the dead" towards the water, towards the earth, and towards
the plants.'
segments.zh: 「若在一年內他們播種或澆灌狗或人死去的那塊地，他們對水、對土、對植物犯了『埋葬死者』的罪。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezi mazdayasna tãm
zãm kârayen ýezi âpô herezayen
ýat ahmi spânasca narasca para-irithiñti añtarât
naêmât ýâre-drâjô kâ-hê
asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If worshippers
of Mazda shall sow or water, within the year, the piece of ground
whereon dogs or men have died, what is the penalty that they shall
pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若馬茲達信仰者在一年內播種或澆灌狗或人死去的那塊地，他們應支付的罰金是何？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti
peshô-tanuye duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They are Peshotanus: two hundred stripes
with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他們是佩紹坦努罪：用馬鞭鞭打二百下，用斯勞沙鞭鞭打二百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezi vasen mazdayasna
zãm raodhayãm hixtayaêca karshtayaêca
parakañtayaêca kutha tê verezyãn aête
ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If worshippers
of Mazda want to till that piece of ground again, to water it,
to sow it, and to plough it, what shall they do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若馬茲達信仰者想再次耕種那塊地、澆灌它、播種它、並犁耙它，他們應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtadha hê
aête mazdayasna ainghå zemô pairishayañta
aêtanghãm astãmca varesãmca spâmãmca
mûthrãmca vanghutâtãmca.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall look on the ground for any
bones, hair, dung, urine, or blood that may be there.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他們應當察看那塊地上可能存在的任何骨頭、毛髮、糞便、尿液或血液。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezi nôit pairishåñte
aêtanghãm astãmca varesãmca spâmãmca
mûthrãmca vanghutâtãmca kâ-hê
asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If they shall
not look on the ground for any bones, hair, dung, urine, or blood
that may be there, what is the penalty that they shall pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若他們不察看那塊地上可能存在的任何骨頭、毛髮、糞便、尿液或血液，他們應支付的罰金是何？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti
peshô-tanuye duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They are Peshotanus: two hundred stripes
with the Aspahe-astra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
 
 II.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它們是佩紹坦努罪：馬鞭二百鞭，斯勞沙鞭二百鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ avavat
aipi ýatha kasishtahe erezvô fratemem tbishish ýezi
ahmya irithyeiti ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs
vâ kâ-hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as the top joint of the little finger, and if grease or
marrow flow from it on to the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗之骨或死人之骨投擲於地，其大小如小指頂節，且若脂肪或骨髓從中流出至地面，他應支付何等刑罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrisatem upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya thrisatem sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Thirty stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
thirty stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭三十鞭，斯勞沙鞭三十鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ avavat
aipi ýatha madhemahe erezvô fratemem tbishish ýezi
ahmya irithyeiti ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs
vâ kâ-hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as the top joint of the fore-finger, and if grease or marrow
flow from it on to the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗之骨或死人之骨投擲於地，其大小如食指頂節，且若脂肪或骨髓從中流出至地面，他應支付何等刑罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, pañcâsatem
upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya pañcâsatem
sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Fifty stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
fifty stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭五十鞭，斯勞沙鞭五十鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ avavat
aipi ýatha masishtahe erezvô fratemem tbishish ýezi
ahmya irithyeiti ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs
vâ kâ-hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as the top joint of the middle finger, and if grease or
marrow flow from it on to the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗之骨或死人之骨投擲於地，其大小如中指頂節，且若脂肪或骨髓從中流出至地面，他應支付何等刑罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, haptâitîm
upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya haptâitîm
sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Seventy stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
seventy stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭七十鞭，斯勞沙鞭七十鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ erezu-stavanghem
vâ peresu-masanghem vâ ýezi ahmya irithyeiti
ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs vâ kâ-
hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as a finger or as a rib, and if grease or marrow flow from
it on to the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗之骨或死人之骨投擲於地，其大小如一指或如肋骨，且若脂肪或骨髓從中流出至地面，他應支付何等刑罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, navaitîm upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya navaitîm sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Ninety stripes with the Aspahe-astra,
ninety stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭鞭打九十下，斯勞沙鞭鞭打九十下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ baêerezu-stavanghem
vâ biperesu-masanghem vâ ýezi ahmya irithyeiti
ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs vâ kâ-
hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as two fingers or as two ribs, and if grease or marrow flow
from it on the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗或死人的骨頭拋在地上，大如兩根手指或兩根肋骨，且油脂或骨髓流滲於地，他應付何種懲罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti
peshô-tanuye duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He is Peshotanu: two hundred stripes
with the Aspahe-ashtra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他是佩紹坦努罪者：馬鞭鞭打二百下，斯勞沙鞭鞭打二百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ bâzu-stavanghem
vâ sraoni-masanghem vâ ýezi ahmya irithyeiti
ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs vâ kâ-
hê asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as an arm-bone or as a thigh-bone, and if grease or marrow
flow from it on the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗或死人的骨頭拋在地上，大如臂骨或股骨，且油脂或骨髓流滲於地，他應付何種懲罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, cathwârô
sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe ashtraya
cathwârô sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Four hundred stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
four hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭鞭打四百下，斯勞沙鞭鞭打四百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô astem upangharezaiti
sûnô vâ para-iristahe mashyehe vâ avavat
aipi ýatha narsh vakhdhanem ýezi ahmya irithyeiti
ûthem vâ ûthô-tâs vâ kâ-hê
asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground a bone of a dead dog, or of a dead man, as
large as a man's skull, and if grease or marrow flow from it on
the ground, what penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗或死人的骨頭拋在地上，大如人之顱骨，且油脂或骨髓流滲於地，他應付何種懲罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, xshvash sata upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya xshvash sata sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Six hundred stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
six hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬鞭鞭打六百下，斯勞沙鞭鞭打六百下。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô vîspãm
haurvãm tanûm upangharezaiti sûnô vâ
para-iristahe mashyehe vâ ýezi ahmya irithyeiti ûthem
vâ ûthô-tâs vâ kâ-hê
asti citha.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man shall
throw on the ground the whole body of a dead dog, or of a dead
man, and if grease or marrow flow from it on the ground, what
penalty shall he pay?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人將死狗或死人的整具屍體拋在地上，且油脂或骨髓流滲於地，他應付何種懲罰？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, hazangrem upâzananãm
upâzôit aspahe ashtraya hazangrem sraoshô-caranaya!
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'A thousand stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
a thousand stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
 
 III.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「用馬鞭打一千鞭，用斯勞沙鞭打一千鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýat aête ýôi
mazdayasna pâdha ayañtem vâ taciñtem
vâ baremnem vâ vazemnem vâ taci-apaya nasâum
frajasãn kutha tê verezyãn aête ýôi
mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a worshipper
of Mazda, walking, or running, or riding, or driving, come upon
a corpse in a stream of running water, what shall he do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！如果一個阿胡拉‧馬茲達的信徒，行走著，或跑步著，或騎馬著，或駕車著，遇見一具屍體在流動的水流中，他應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, mat aothranãm
framuxti mat vastranãm nidhâiti upa- mãnayen
zarathushtra frasha frayôit iristem uzbarôit âpô
zarathushtra â-zañgaêibyascit âpô
â-zhnubyascit âpô â-maidhyãnascit
âpô â-nereberezascit âpô vîspem
â ahmât ýadhôit upa-jasôit iristãm
tanûm.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Taking off his shoes, putting off his
clothes, while the others wait, O Zarathushtra! he shall enter
the river, and take the dead out of the water; he shall go down
into the water ankle-deep, knee-deep, waist-deep, or a man's full
depth, till he can reach the dead body.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「脫去他的鞋子，脫去他的衣服，當眾人等待著時，查拉圖斯特拉啊！他應當進入河中，將死者從水中取出；他應當踏入水中，至腳踝深，至膝蓋深，至腰部深，或至一個人的全身深度，直到他能夠到達屍體。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezica aête nasâvô
frithyeitica puyetica kutha tê verezyãn aête
ýôi mazdayasna.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If, however,
the body be already falling to pieces and rotting, what shall
the worshipper of Mazda do?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！但是，如果屍體已經開始碎裂和腐爛，阿胡拉‧馬茲達的信徒應當做什麼？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýavat cvatca
hê zastaêibya hañgeurvayãn aêtavat
apat haca nizhbârayen hushe zeme nidaithyãn nôit
astãm nôit varsãm nôit spâmãm
nôit mûthrãm nôit vanghutâtãm
pairi- spâiti apãm âstryåñte.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He shall draw out of the water as much
of the corpse as he can grasp with both hands, and he shall lay
it down on the dry ground; no sin attaches to him for any bone,
hair, grease, dung, urine, or blood that may drop back into the
water.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他應當從水中拉出盡可能多的屍體，以至於他能用雙手握住的部分，並將其放在乾燥的地面上；任何骨頭、毛髮、油脂、糞便、尿液或血液掉回水中的，對他都不構成罪過。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat aêtanghå âpô
ýat armaêshtayå aêsha druxsh ýâ
nasush axtica pivatica âhitica frâshnaoiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What part of
the water in a pond does the Druj Nasu defile with corruption,
infection, and pollution?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染了池塘中水的哪一部分？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, xshvash-gâim
kemcit paiti cathrushanãm vîspem â ahmât
aêsha âfsh ayaozhdya anaiwish-hvaretha ýavat
aêsha nasush nizhbereta, us haca nasâvô aêtavat
apat haca nizhbârayen hushe zeme nidaithyãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Six steps on each of the four sides.
As long as the corpse has not been taken out of the water, so
long shall that water be unclean and unfit to drink. They shall,
therefore, take the corpse out of the pond, and lay it down on
the dry ground.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「四邊各六步。只要屍體還未被從水中取出，那水就將保持不潔淨和不適於飲用。因此他們應當將屍體從池塘中取出，並將其放在乾燥的地面上。」

segments.orig:
ainghå âpô para-hiñcayen ýat
vâ naêmem ýat vâ thrishum ýat
vâ cathrushum ýat vâ pangtanghum ýezi
tûtava navât tûtava, pasca nasâvô
nizhberethi pasca âpô para-hixti aêsha âfsh
ýaozhdya bavaiti vasô aiwish-hvaretha pasubya vîraêibya
hamatha ýatha paracit.
segments.en:
'And of the water they shall draw off the half, or the third,
or the fourth, or the fifth part, according as they are able or
not; and after the corpse has been taken out and the water has
been drawn off, the rest of the water is clean, and both cattle
and men may drink of it at their pleasure, as before.'
segments.zh: 「他們應當從水中排出一半、或三分之一、或四分之一、或五分之一，根據他們的能力或無法做到；屍體被取出後，水被排出後，其餘的水就是潔淨的，牲畜和人類都可以按照他們的願望飲用，如同以前一樣。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat aêtanghå âpô
ýat câtayå uzuityåsca aêsha druxsh
ýâ nasush axtica pivatica âhitica frâshnaoiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What part of
the water in a well does the Druj Nasu defile with corruption,
infection, and pollution?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染了井中水的哪一部分？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, vîspem â
ahmât aêsha âfsh ayaozhdya anaiwish- hvaretha
ýavat aêsha nasush nizhbereta, us haca ... ýatha
paracit.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'As long as the corpse has not been
taken out of the water, so long shall that water be unclean and
unfit to drink. They shall, therefore, take the corpse out of
the well, and lay it down on the dry ground.
'And of the water in the well they shall draw off the half,
or the third, or the fourth, or the fifth part, according as they
are able or not; and after the corpse has been taken out and the
water has been drawn off, the rest of the water is clean, and
both cattle and men may drink of it at their pleasure, as before.'
segments.zh:
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「只要屍體尚未被取出水外，那水就應當是不潔與不適於飲用的。因此他們應當將屍體取出井外，並將其置於乾燥的地上。
井中的水他們應當抽出其中一半，或三分之一，或四分之一，或五分之一，視其能力而定；在屍體被取出且水被抽出之後，其餘的水就是潔淨的，牛畜與人都可按其意願飲用，如同以前一樣。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat aêtanghå âpô
ýat snaêzhiñtyâica srasciñtyâica
aêsha druxsh ýâ nasush axtica pivatica âhitica
frâshnaoiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What part of
a sheet of snow or hail does the Druj Nasu defile with corruption,
infection, and pollution?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染了雪或冰雹的哪一部分？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrigâim kemcit
paiti cathrushanãm vîspem â ahmât aêsha
âfsh ayaozhdya anaiwish-hvaretha ýavat aêsha
nasush nizhbereta, us haca nasâvô aêtavat apat
haca nizhbârayen hushe zeme nidaithyãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Three steps
on each of the four sides.
As long as the corpse has not been taken out of the water, so
long shall that water be unclean and unfit to drink. They shall,
therefore, take the corpse out of the pond, and lay it down on
the dry ground.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「四方各側三步。只要屍體尚未被取出水外，那水就應當是不潔與不適於飲用的。因此他們應當將屍體取出池塘，並將其置於乾燥的地上。

segments.orig:
pasca nasâvô nizhberethi pasca âpô
vîtaxti aêsha âfsh ýaozhdya bavaiti vasô
aiwish-hvaretha pasubya vîraêibya hamatha ýatha
paracit.
segments.en:
'After the corpse has been taken out, and the snow or the
hail has melted, the water is clean, and both cattle and men may
drink of it at their pleasure, as before.'
segments.zh: 屍體被取出之後，雪或冰雹已融化，水就是潔淨的，牛畜與人都可按其意願飲用，如同以前一樣。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat aêtanghå âpô
ýat frâtat-caretayå aêsha druxsh ýâ
nasush axtica pivatica âhitica frâshnaoiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! What part of
the water of a running stream does the Druj Nasu defile with corruption,
infection, and pollution?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！德魯格‧納蘇以腐敗、感染與污穢污染了流水溪流中的哪一部分？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrigâim nyâpem
nava-gâim paityâpem xshvash-gâim anaidhîm
vîspem â ahmât ... nidaithyãn.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'Three steps down the stream, nine steps
up the stream, six steps across. As long as the corpse has not
been taken out of the water, so long shall that water be unclean
and unfit to drink. They shall, therefore, take the corpse out
of the pond, and lay it down on the dry ground.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「下流三步，上流九步，橫向六步。只要屍體尚未被取出水外，那水就應當是不潔與不適於飲用的。因此他們應當將屍體取出池塘，並將其置於乾燥的地上。

segments.orig:
pasca nasâvô nizhberethi pasca âthritîm
aiwi-varaiti aêsha âfsh ýaozhdya bavaiti vasô
aiwish-hvaretha pasubya vîraêibya hamatha ýatha
paracit!
segments.en:
'After the corpse has been taken out and
the stream has flowed three times, the water is
clean, and both cattle and men may drink
of it at their pleasure, as before.'
segments.zh: 屍體被取出且溪水已流過三次之後，水就是潔淨的，牛畜與人都可按其意願飲用，如同以前一樣。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kat tâ haoma ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum ahura mazda ýâ nasâum ava-bereta
sûnô vâ para- iristahe mashyehe vâ.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Can the Haoma
that has been touched with Nasu from a dead dog, or from a dead
man, be made clean again?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！被死狗或死人的納蘇所觸碰的豪麻，能否再次被淨潔？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, ýaozhdayãn
anghen ashâum zarathushtra nôit haomô hutô
axtish nôit mahrkô nôit nasush ava-beretô
ava aête ahuta ýatha cathwârô erezvô
aêtaêshãmca zemô nidaithyãn añtare
aredhem nmânahe vîspem â ahmât ýat
hê ýâre-drâjô sacâite, âat
pasca ýâre-drâjô vasô hvarethå
anghen nerebyô ashavabyô hamatha ýatha paracit!
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'It can, O holy Zarathushtra! If it
has been prepared for the
sacrifice, there is to it no corruption, no death, no
touch of any Nasu. If it has not been prepared
for the sacrifice, [the stem] is defiled the length of
four fingers: it shall be laid down on the ground,
in the middle of the house, for a year long. When
 the year is passed, the faithful may drink of its juice
at their pleasure, as before.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「它能被淨潔，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉啊！如果它已被準備為獻祭之用，則它沒有腐敗，沒有死亡，沒有任何納蘇的觸碰。如果它未被準備為獻祭之用，〔莖〕則在四指的長度內被污染：它應被放置在地上，在房屋的中央，持續一年。當一年已過，信眾可隨其意願飲用其汁液，如同從前。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kva narãm iristanãm
tanûm barâma ahura mazda kva nidathâma.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou holy One! Whither shall
we bring, where shall we lay the bodies of the dead, O Ahura Mazda?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！我們應將死者的屍體帶往何處，應在何處安放它們呢，阿胡拉‧馬茲達？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, barezishtaêshvaca
paiti gâtushva spitama zarathushtra ýadhôit
dim bâidhishtem avazanãm sûnô vâ
kerefsh- hvarô vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'On the highest summits, where they
know there are always corpse-eating dogs and corpse-eating birds,
O holy Zarathushtra!
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「在最高的山頂處，斯皮塔瑪‧查拉圖斯特拉啊，在那裡你們知道總有食屍的狗和食屍的鳥！」

segments.orig:
aêtadha hê aête mazdayasna aêtem iristem
nidarezayen havaêibya pâdhaêibya hvaêpathyâca
varsa ayanghaênem vâ zarshtvaênem vâ fravâxshaênem
vâ ýezi nôit sûnô vâ kerefsh-hvarô
vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô aêtanghãm
astãm avi apãmca urvaranãmca bareñtem
frajasãn.
segments.en:
'There shall the worshippers of Mazda fasten the corpse, by
the feet and by the hair, with iron, stones, or clay, lest the
corpse-eating dogs and the corpse-eating birds shall go and carry
the bones to the water and to the trees.
segments.zh: 「在那裡馬茲達的信眾應將屍體用鐵、石頭或泥土以足與頭髮固定，以免食屍的狗和食屍的鳥去運載骨骸至水和樹木處。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýezi nôit nidarezyåñte
aêtadha hê aête sûnô vâ kerefsh-hvarô
vayô vâ kerefsh-hvarô aêtanghãm
astãm avi apãmca urvaranãmca bareñtem
frajasât kâ-hê asti citha.
segments.en:
'If they shall not fasten the corpse, so that the corpse-eating
dogs and the corpse-eating birds may go and carry the bones to
the water and to the trees, what is the penalty that they shall
pay?'
segments.zh: 「如果他們不固定屍體，致使食屍的狗和食屍的鳥去運載骨骸至水和樹木處，他們應付出何種刑罰？」

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, aêtahe paiti
peshô-tanuye duye saite upâzananãm upâzôit
aspahe ashtraya duye saite sraoshô-caranaya.
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They shall be Peshotanus: two hundred
stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「他們應成為佩紹坦努罪：二百鞭馬鞭，二百鞭斯勞沙鞭。」

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum kva narãm iristanãm
azdibîsh barâma ahura mazda kva nidathâma.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! Whither shall
we bring, where shall we lay the bones of the dead, O Ahura Mazda?
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！我們應將死者的骨骸帶往何處，應在何處安放它們呢，阿胡拉‧馬茲達？

segments.orig:
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, uzhdânem hê
adhât kerenaot upairi spânem upairi raozhem upairi
vehrkem anaiwi-vareñtîm upara-naêmât
apô ýat vairyayå
segments.en:
Ahura Mazda answered: 'The worshippers
of Mazda shall make a receptacle out of
the reach of the dog, of the fox, and of the
wolf, and wherein rain-water cannot stay.
segments.zh: 阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「馬茲達的信奉者應當製作一個容器，放在狗、狐狸及狼無法觸及的地方，其中雨水也無法停留。」

segments.orig:
ýezi tavãn aête mazdayasna ýezi
asânaêshva ýezi vîcicaêshva ýezi
tûtuxshva, ýezi nôit tavãn aête
mazdayasna hvâ-stairish hvâ-barezish raocå aiwi-varena
hvare-daresya hê zeme paiti nidaithîta! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
'They shall make it, if they can afford
it, with stones, plaster, or earth; if they cannot
afford it, they shall lay down the dead man on the
ground, on his carpet and his pillow, clothed with
the light of heaven, and beholding the sun.'
segments.zh: 「如果他們能夠負擔，他們應當用石頭、灰泥或泥土來製作它；如果他們無法負擔，他們應當把死人放在地上，放在他的地毯和枕頭上，穿著天堂的光，看著太陽。」
